Base directory for this skill: /Users/joelmoss/dev/workroom/.claude/skills/curate-release

Tag-driven (see README "Releases"). After a release publishes, **curate its GitHub release
notes** — replace GoReleaser's raw commit list with a succinct, themed summary in the style of
`v2.0.0-beta.1` (a headline, a one-line framing, and grouped bullets). The commit list is what
the git log is for.

**Never hard-wrap paragraph or bullet text at a fixed column.** Write each paragraph and each
bullet as one unbroken line, however long. The in-app "What's New" viewer renders a literal `\n`
as a line break instead of reflowing it, so a source line wrapped at ~90 cols shows up as a
sentence broken mid-clause. Markdown block structure (headers, blank lines between paragraphs,
`-` bullets, blockquotes) is unaffected — only the wrapping *within* a block must go.

**Release channels** (issue #91) ship as **two products**. The **main** product (`workroom` CLI +
"Workroom" app) tracks `stable` or `pre`, chosen at runtime (`workroom update --channel stable|pre`;
the app's Settings picker). **Nightly** is a **separate side-by-side install** — a `workroom-nightly`
binary (baked `-X main.channel=nightly`) and a distinct "Workroom Nightly" app (`Nightly` build
config in `project.yml`: bundle id `…workroom.nightly`, `AppIcon-Nightly`, `WorkroomReleaseChannel`
Info.plist marker). Channel is a runtime pref for stable/pre, a build identity for nightly, so
nothing can drift/collide (the main binary rejects `--channel nightly`).

Canonical tag→channel classification is `internal/channel` (Go), mirrored by
`macapp/WorkroomApp/Core/ReleaseChannel.swift` and `macapp/Scripts/channel-helper.sh` — **keep the
three in lockstep**. The updater selects per channel (stable = `/releases/latest` for byte-parity;
pre = `/releases` list, newest stable-or-prerelease; nightly = the fixed `nightly` release by tag),
orders nightlies by the monotonic commit-count and everything else by semver, and verifies against
`checksums.txt`. Nightly is a scheduled build (`.github/workflows/nightly.yml`, daily cron;
`CONFIGURATION=Nightly make app-release`) on a fixed `nightly` prerelease; all appcast-writing
workflows share a `concurrency: appcast-feed` group.

926	## Deployment & Releases
927	
928	There is no server to deploy — Workroom is a desktop app plus a CLI distributed through **GitHub
929	Releases**. "Deployment" here means cutting a release: GitHub Actions builds and publishes both
930	components automatically when you push a version tag.
931	
932	### Continuous integration
933	
934	`.github/workflows/ci.yml` runs on every push to `master` and every PR against it:
935	
936	- **`cli` job** (`ubuntu-latest`): sets up Go from `go.mod`, runs `golangci-lint` (subsumes `go vet`
937	  / `gofmt`), `go build`, and `go test ./...`.
938	- **`app` job** (`macos-15`): sets up Xcode + Go, `brew install xcodegen jj`, runs `make app-lint`
939	  (swift-format `--strict`) and `make app-test` with **ad-hoc signing** flags (hosted runners have
940	  no signing cert), e.g.:
941	
942	  ```
943	  CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=- CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO DEVELOPMENT_TEAM=
944	  ```
945	
946	### Cutting a release
947	
948	Releases are **tag-driven**. Push a `v*` tag and `.github/workflows/release.yml` does the rest:
949	
950	```bash
951	git tag v1.4.0
952	git push origin v1.4.0
953	```
954	
955	A clean `vX.Y.Z` tag publishes as a normal ("Latest") release; a tag with a prerelease component
956	(e.g. `v2.0.0-beta.1`, `v1.4.0-rc1`) is auto-marked as a GitHub **pre-release** so it never becomes
957	"Latest" (GoReleaser `prerelease: auto`).
958	
959	You can test the CLI build locally with [GoReleaser](https://goreleaser.com/) before tagging
960	(produces binaries in `dist/` without publishing):
961	
962	```bash
963	goreleaser build --snapshot --clean
964	```
965	
966	**After a release publishes, curate its GitHub release notes** — replace GoReleaser's raw commit
967	list with a succinct, themed summary (a headline, a one-line framing, and grouped bullets). Editing
968	the release notes also triggers `appcast-notes.yml`, which re-renders the Sparkle update dialog's
969	notes from your curated body.
970	
971	### Release channels
972	
973	Channels are delivered as **two products**, not one switchable install:
974	
975	- **Main product** — one install (the `workroom` CLI and the "Workroom" app) that tracks **stable**
976	  or **pre**, chosen at runtime (`workroom update --channel stable|pre`, or the app's *Settings ▸
977	  General ▸ Release channel*). Mutually exclusive; no side-by-side.
978	- **Nightly product** — a **separate download** (the `workroom-nightly` CLI and a distinct "Workroom
979	  Nightly" app: own bundle id `…workroom.nightly`, name, violet icon) pinned to nightly, running
980	  **alongside** the main install (and the Debug "Workroom Dev" build). Channel here is a *build
981	  identity*, not a runtime preference, so nothing can drift or collide.
982	
983	| Channel | Source | Appcast tagging | Delivered as |
984	| --- | --- | --- | --- |
985	| `stable` | clean `vX.Y.Z` tags | untagged (Sparkle default — everyone) | main app / `workroom` |
986	| `pre` | `vX.Y.Z-beta.N` / `-rc` / `-alpha` tags | `<sparkle:channel>pre</sparkle:channel>` | main app / `workroom` |
987	| `nightly` | daily build off `master` | `<sparkle:channel>nightly</sparkle:channel>` | Workroom Nightly / `workroom-nightly` |
988	
989	`stable` and `pre` fall out of the normal tag-driven release above. **Nightly** is a scheduled
990	build — `.github/workflows/nightly.yml` runs on a daily cron (and `workflow_dispatch`), building the
991	`Nightly` configuration ("Workroom Nightly" app) and baking `-X main.channel=nightly` into the CLI
992	archives. It's hosted on a single fixed **`nightly`** prerelease whose assets and appcast item are
993	clobbered in place each run (no per-day tags accumulate). Its version is
994	`<incpatch(latest-tag)>-nightly.<commit-count>`; the commit count is the monotonic key the CLI and
995	Sparkle order nightlies by. A no-new-commits guard skips a run when nothing changed, and the release
996	title (the version) is stamped only after assets + appcast publish succeed, so a partial run retries.
997	
998	One appcast feed carries all channels; the main app's `allowedChannels` is the picked stable/pre
999	floor while the nightly app's is fixed to `{nightly}`, and Sparkle's bundle-id check is the backstop
1000	that stops either from ever installing the other's DMG. The canonical tag → channel classification
1001	lives in **`internal/channel`** (Go), mirrored by `macapp/WorkroomApp/Core/ReleaseChannel.swift` and
1002	`macapp/Scripts/channel-helper.sh` — keep the three in sync. All appcast-writing workflows
1003	(`release`, `nightly`, `appcast-notes`) share a `concurrency: appcast-feed` group so they can't
1004	clobber each other's `appcast.xml` edits.

1017	| `NOTARY_KEY_ID` | App Store Connect API key ID |
1018	| `NOTARY_ISSUER_ID` | App Store Connect issuer ID |

Fix: switch those two fixtures to `jj describe -m`, matching what Workroom's real commit path does.
